en: Tell me, have you heard of the Battle Frontier?
text: Spune-mi, ai auzit de Battle Frontier?

en: Then you're someone who keeps up with things.
It's meant to be great fun: halls for battling in, each with rules all its own.
text: Se zice că e foarte distractiv: săli de luptă, fiecare cu regulile ei.

en: Then you're a little behind the times, I'd say.
It's meant to be great fun: halls where you battle one Trainer after another, each with rules all its own.
text: Atunci ai cam rămas în urmă cu noutățile, aș zice.
Se zice că e foarte distractiv: săli unde te lupți cu un Antrenor după altul, fiecare cu regulile ei.
